root_cause.text: The error cleanup path in `setup_nic_devices()` used a post-decrement `while (i--)` loop, which immediately decremented the index `i` before executing the loop body, thereby skipping the cleanup of the device at the failing index and causing a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the replacement of the `while (i--)` loop with a `do { ... } while (i--)` loop under the `setup_nic_dev_free` label, ensuring that `liquidio_destroy_nic_device(octeon_dev, i)` is executed for the current index `i` before it is decremented.
